title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Caribb Crush Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Caribb Crush blends creamy Coconut, juicy Mango and sweet Pineapple for a smooth, tropical vape that’s bright and flavourful. Each puff delivers sun-soaked fruit sweetness with a mellow, rounded finish. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod includes a prefilled 2ml pod connected to a 10ml refill reservoir, totalling 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No refilling or coil swaps are needed—simply connect the pod to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. With dual mesh coils and draw-activation, this pod provides rich flavour and steady vapour for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
